task_summary: Implement strip_prefix in solution.py and add standard-library unittest coverage in test_solution.py.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Remove exactly one matching prefix. A nonmatching or empty prefix leaves text unchanged. Do not strip individual characters or repeated prefixes.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
Include at least 2 passing unittest test methods that exercise the public API.

success_criteria.description: solution.py defines a public strip_prefix function.
test_solution.py contains at least two unittest test methods.
Unittest discovery runs the suite successfully, including the requested public API coverage.

assumptions: The named files are relative to the supplied workspace; solution.py and test_solution.py may not exist yet and may be created.
Assume the public API accepts text and prefix values as strings, because no parameter types or signature were specified.
The specific test cases for ordinary, boundary, and empty inputs can be selected to demonstrate the stated public behavior.
Unittest discovery from the workspace root will find test_solution.py and its tests.
